messages:
Maria: NordicSupply alerted — EU replenishment for our reserved H100 cohort delayed. Vendor says 6 units stuck at customs (doc mismatch) and 10 queued for additional thermal QA. New ETA ~ +3 weeks.
Nguyen: Which serial ranges and customer allocations are impacted?
Maria: Affected allocations: EU-enterprise-03 (3 units), DE-onprem-eval (4 units), EU-burst-reserve (9 units).
Oliver (NordicSupply): Confirmed. 6 units flagged HS-code paperwork; 10 units in thermal hold. We can do a split: ship 6 expedited by air, remainder by sea. Air premium ~€2.6k/unit if you request now.
Lina: Could we instead cross-borrow from US spare pool while EU clears? Need cost/clearing overhead calc.
Sam: Cross-borrow path: decommit US spares, ship to EU: transit 5-7d + re-import brokerage & VAT handling. Rough all-in ≈ €3.8-4.5k/unit. Still likely cheaper than extended SLO breaches.
Nguyen: On-prem customers in DE are high priority — need zero downtime SLA window. Can vendor provide temporary refurb swap while originals clear customs?
Oliver (NordicSupply): We can stage 6 certified refurb units (same model family) as temporary replacements. Refurbs will have baseline firmware; we recommend a quick parity pass before handoff.
Sam: Ops constraints: if we accept refurbs, schedule a 48h canary in staging (2 units) to test firmware/thermal behavior, then approve. Also need AMI + provisioning tweak docs.
Lina: I'll draft a firmware parity checklist and coordinate image updates.
Maria: Procurement/contract: vendor will need PO ref to issue HS attestation. Procurement — can you sign PO-7291 today?
Procurement: PO-7291 recorded. Will send signed HS attestation and commercial invoice to Oliver.
Oliver (NordicSupply): Received PO-7291 once you send attestation. We can also push provisional AWBs to speed customs once docs land. I can cover 40% of air premium; Redwood covers brokerage if mis-declaration found.
Nguyen: That split sounds reasonable. We want vendor to commit to provisional AWBs and a warranty notice on refurb parity.
Oliver (NordicSupply): Will include warranty addendum for refurbs and provisional AWBs (tracking IDs created after docs).
ops-bot: Actionable: open an incident for capacity-shortfall if latency > SLO during replacement. Create at /incidents/new and tag #eng-sre.
Maria: I'll open the incident and tag SRE. Sam, reserve US spares as fallback; don't ship unless we decide cross-borrow.
Sam: Reserved 4 US spare units in the pool as hold. Marked them as "cross-borrow fallback" in inventory.
Lina: Attestation and invoice uploaded to vendor email thread.
Nguyen: Decision timeline recap: EOD send signed attestation (Procurement/Lina). Vendor to issue provisional AWBs within 24h. We decide air-split vs cross-borrow by 12:00 UTC tomorrow. Canary to run 48h before enterprise handoff.
Maria: Agreed. We'll prefer vendor air-split for the enterprise-critical units if vendor accepts 40% premium cover. Otherwise, cross-borrow fallback.
Oliver (NordicSupply): Noted. Creating AWB ticket: `AWB-8914`. Will update customs clearance status as docs clear.
Maria: Thanks. Keep thread updated with AWB and customs status.
Nguyen: Also log any firmware mismatches in the canary ticket: `CANARY-564`.
Sam: I'll add AMI change notes and smoke test steps into CANARY-564.
Maria: Closing this update — next post once AWB-8914 updates. :thumbsup:
